        J=np.vstack([jp[:,s._jv[:7]], jr[:,s._jv[:7]]])

        dq=A.T@np.linalg.solve(A@A.T+np.diag([1e-4]*3+[2e-3]*3),b)
        dq=np.clip(dq,-.15,.15); q+=dq

    # restore current sim position and forward

        p=s.data.xpos[bid].copy(); R=s.data.xmat[bid].reshape(3,3).copy()
        ep=pgoal-p; er=Rotation.from_matrix(Rgoal@R.T).as_rotvec()
        jp=np.zeros((3,s.model.nv)); jr=np.zeros((3,s.model.nv)); mujoco.mj_jacBody(s.model,s.data,jp,jr,bid)
        J=np.vstack([jp[:,s._jv[:7]], jr[:,s._jv[:7]]]); W=np.diag([1,1,1,.22,.22,.22]); A=W@J; b=W@np.r_[ep,er]

    t = float(np.clip(t, 0.0, 1.0))
    return t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t)


def arm_ik(pos_goal, rot_goal):
    """Damped least squares IK for the palm body, returning seven iiwa targets."""
    actual = d.qpos[s._jq[:7]].copy()
    q = actual.copy()
    for _ in range(18):
